instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing ellipse sketch with 18 mm major radius and 10 mm minor radius as the base profile. Create a 12 mm Part Design pad from the ellipse, then remove the front face and apply a 2 mm Part Design Thickness feature to make an open elliptical shell. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
